Crime & Law · India

Courts impose lengthy sentences in separate POCSO and pre-trial detention cases

In Odisha, a father received a 20-year sentence under the POCSO Act for what a court termed an 'unspeakable betrayal of trust'. Separately, in Kerala, a man spent 39 years as a remand prisoner without trial, a period exceeding twice the potential sentence for murder. Another Kerala man, a cricket coach, faces an accumulated 35-year jail term across three POCSO verdicts.
